## Conclusion

Gold-Band currently has **no checked-in headless ACP smoke test, agent fixture, or CLI subcommand** that accepts an arbitrary ACP command and drives the complete lifecycle.

In particular:

- The documented commands `gold-band provider doctor` and `gold-band provider test` are **design-only**; they are not implemented in [`E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\gold-band\src\cli\mod.rs`](E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\gold-band\src\cli\mod.rs).
- Existing Rust ACP tests test routing, persistence, replay, and synthetic providers. None launches a functioning external ACP agent through Gold-Band’s production client.
- Existing web tests do not launch the Rust ACP client.
- No checked-in mock/fake ACP stdio executable exists under the Gold-Band submodule.

## Smallest existing production-client probe

The smallest production path is:

```rust
gold_band::acp::client::doctor(...)
```

Defined in:

- [`E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\gold-band\src\acp\client.rs:2305`](E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\gold-band\src\acp\client.rs)
- Process spawning: [`E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\gold-band\src\acp\adapter.rs:38`](E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\gold-band\src\acp\adapter.rs)
- Stdio connection: [`E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\gold-band\src\acp\connection.rs:1051`](E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\gold-band\src\acp\connection.rs)

It accepts this configuration directly:

```rust
AcpAdapterConfig {
    command: r"E:\path\to\agent.bat".to_string(),
    args: vec![
        "acp".to_string(),
        "--protocol".to_string(),
        "v1".to_string(),
        "--stdio".to_string(),
    ],
    display_name: "Local ACP Agent".to_string(),
    env: BTreeMap::from([
        ("NAME".to_string(), "value".to_string()),
    ]),
}
```

However, `doctor` is exposed only through the desktop Tauri command `doctor_agent`, not through the headless CLI:

- [`E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\gold-band\src-tauri\src\commands.rs:2686`](E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\gold-band\src-tauri\src\commands.rs)

### What `doctor` exercises

| ACP operation | Exercised? | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| `initialize` | Yes | Real JSON-RPC over the spawned process’s stdin/stdout |
| `session/new` | Yes | Empty system prompt, no MCP servers |
| `session/update` | Conditional | Drains updates for up to 500 ms, mainly for `available_commands_update` |
| `session/prompt` | No | Doctor never sends a prompt |
| `session/delete` | Yes, first choice | Diagnostic cleanup prefers delete |
| `session/close` | Fallback only | Sent only if `session/delete` fails |
| Process shutdown | Yes | The standalone adapter process tree is terminated |

Important consequence: because JI implements `session/delete`, Gold-Band Doctor will normally test **delete, not close**.

## Turnkey no-submodule-modification route

The only existing turnkey route is the desktop application:

```powershell
Set-Location "E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\gold-band"
npm run dev
```

In Agent Management, create a custom Agent with:

```text
Agent ID: ji-local
Display name: JI Local
Command: E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\ji-java\products\ji-cli\build\install\ji\bin\ji.bat
Arguments:
acp
--protocol
v1
--stdio
```

Environment:

```text
JI_LLM_MODEL=<model-id>
JI_LLM_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:<port>/<openai-compatible-path>
JI_WORKSPACE_ROOT=E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji
JI_DATA_DIR=<directory-outside-gold-band>
```

If `JI_LLM_API_KEY` is set, JI also requires:

```text
JI_CREDENTIAL_MASTER_KEY=<master-key>
```

The JI launcher already exists at:

[`E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\ji-java\products\ji-cli\build\install\ji\bin\ji.bat`](E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\ji-java\products\ji-cli\build\install\ji\bin\ji.bat)

To rebuild that launcher if necessary:

```powershell
& "E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\gradlew.bat" :ji-cli:installDist
```

JI’s ACP command is implemented in:

- [`E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\ji-java\products\ji-cli\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\cli\JiCli.java:75`](E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\ji-java\products\ji-cli\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\cli\JiCli.java)
- [`E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\ji-java\protocols\ji-acp-v1-server\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\acp\v1\AcpV1Server.java`](E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\ji-java\protocols\ji-acp-v1-server\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\acp\v1\AcpV1Server.java)

Then:

1. Run **Environment Doctor** to exercise `initialize`, `session/new`, optional updates, and `session/delete`.
2. Start a Direct conversation to exercise `initialize`, `session/new`, `session/prompt`, and `session/update`.
3. Close/delete the session, close the workspace, or exit the desktop app to invoke Gold-Band’s bounded connection shutdown and `session/close`.

This covers the full lifecycle, but it is not headless.

## Closest existing headless command

Gold-Band’s implemented headless execution command is:

```powershell
Set-Location "E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji"
cargo run --manifest-path "E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\gold-band\Cargo.toml" -- run start task-001
```

Or with an explicit workflow:

```powershell
cargo run --manifest-path "E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\gold-band\Cargo.toml" -- `
  run start task-001 `
  --workflow "C:\outside-gold-band\ji-acp-smoke-workflow.json"
```

Custom Agent settings are read from:

```text
%GOLD_BAND_HOME%\.gold-band\settings.json
```

If `GOLD_BAND_HOME` is unset, they are normally read from:

```text
%USERPROFILE%\.gold-band\settings.json
```

Relevant path logic is in:

- [`E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\gold-band\src\storage\mod.rs:249`](E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\gold-band\src\storage\mod.rs)
- [`E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\gold-band\src\storage\mod.rs:903`](E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\gold-band\src\storage\mod.rs)

A custom Agent entry has this shape:

```json
{
  "settingsSchemaVersion": 10,
  "agents": {
    "ji-local": {
      "adapter": {
        "command": "E:\\Projects\\Code\\AI\\Ji\\ji-java\\products\\ji-cli\\build\\install\\ji\\bin\\ji.bat",
        "args": ["acp", "--protocol", "v1", "--stdio"],
        "displayName": "JI Local",
        "env": {
          "JI_LLM_MODEL": "<model-id>",
          "JI_LLM_BASE_URL": "http://127.0.0.1:<port>/<path>",
          "JI_WORKSPACE_ROOT": "E:\\Projects\\Code\\AI\\Ji",
          "JI_DATA_DIR": "C:\\outside-gold-band\\ji-smoke-data"
        }
      },
      "icon": "agent",
      "primaryAgentDir": null,
      "projectPrimaryAgentDir": null,
      "compatibleAgentDirs": [],
      "systemPromptDelivery": "none",
      "externalSessionSyncSupported": false,
      "externalSessionSyncEnabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

The explicit workflow can be a single raw worker:

```json
{
  "version": "0.1",
  "id": "ji-acp-smoke",
  "entry": "smoke",
  "control": {
    "max_attempts": 1
  },
  "nodes": [
    {
      "id": "smoke",
      "type": "worker",
      "provider": "ji-local",
      "profile": null,
      "goal": null,
      "output": null,
      "success_condition": null,
      "manual_check": false,
      "prompt_envelope": "raw-agent"
    }
  ],
  "edges": [
    {
      "from": "smoke",
      "to": "$end",
      "on": "success"
    }
  ]
}
```

A pre-existing task must also contain:

```text
%GOLD_BAND_HOME%\.gold-band\projects\<workspace-project-id>\tasks\task-001\task.json
%GOLD_BAND_HOME%\.gold-band\projects\<workspace-project-id>\tasks\task-001\authoring\requirement.md
```

There is no CLI command that creates these fixtures, which is the principal limitation of this headless route.

### What `run start` exercises

| ACP operation | Exercised? |
|---|---:|
| `initialize` | Yes |
| `session/new` | Yes |
| `session/prompt` | Yes |
| `session/update` | Yes, if emitted by the Agent |
| `session/close` | No |

After a successful prompt, Gold-Band intentionally retains the managed ACP session for continuation. When the short-lived CLI exits, the transport/process ends, but the CLI does not perform a protocol-level `session/close`.

The production prompt path is in:

- [`E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\gold-band\src\provider\mod.rs:1489`](E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\gold-band\src\provider\mod.rs)
- [`E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\gold-band\src\acp\client.rs:2385`](E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\gold-band\src\acp\client.rs)
- [`E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\gold-band\src\app\node_executor.rs:496`](E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\gold-band\src\app\node_executor.rs)

## Final recommendation

- **Fewest moving parts:** use `npm run dev`, configure `ji-local`, run Doctor, send one Direct prompt, then close the app/session.
- **Headless initialize/new probe:** use a small external Rust harness calling public `gold_band::acp::client::doctor`; no Gold-Band source modification is needed.
- **Headless prompt/update probe:** use `cargo run ... run start` with externally prepared settings/task/workflow state.
- **Headless full initialize/new/prompt/update/close:** no existing single command or test provides it. An external harness must call the production prompt path and then `gold_band::acp::client::close_all_connections_bounded()` or `close_workspace_connections_bounded()` after the prompt.
